info.cls_ename: Department of Foreign Languages and Literature

description.describe_ch: 本課程預計採主題式教學，透過不同的主題來思考、理解不同文化之間的對話和交流，並進一步了解「跨文化」一詞的本質。此外，在本課程中，同學們也將透過互動的方式，來探索、發想如何解決跨文化對話之後所產生的衝突。
description.describe_eh: translating/interpreting skills with global, technical topics such as environment, Industry 4.0 machinery, and Artificial Intelligence, etc. Students can integrate their language abilities, and apply the techniques learned in this course to their workplace.

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: On a topic related to culture of the student's choice

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
Mid-term to be in the form of an in-class test based on a video presentation
Physical attendance per se does NOT amount to In-class participation.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Attendance expected and appreciated 請準時到課.
2. In-class participation encouraged and appreciated. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. Attendance will not be taken on a regular basis, though students will need rigorous documentation for leave of absence for an exam or a presentation that concerns grading.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
4. Purchase of the textbook will be encouraged, but not required. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
5. No plagiarism or cheating or any misconduct will be tolerated. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
All are welcome...especially international students!
In-class participation and attendance will account for 20% of your final grade.
The first assignment, which will take the form of a skit, will account for 40% of it.
Finally, the final group presentation, which will be on a topic of the student's choice, will account for the remaining 40%.
Conducted in English (EMI).
There will be NO written tests!
Please join our class LINE group, where we share all information.
Please feel free to raise all your concerns with me by email or on LINE.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
As a bottom line, no food and drinks during class sessions, please.
Drinking water will be fine.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
Please try not to be late.
Please try not to miss and session.
Please no eating and drinking in class.
It will be a fun course...a venue where everybody gets to express their views and share them with everybody else.
Most importantly, there will be generous cash prizes handed out by me to the most hard-working ones of you.
All are welcome...especially international students!
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
No plagiarism will be tolerated.
Any cheating, as well as all misconduct, if detected, will be reported to the university's relevant committee for further discipline.
A brief video on academic integrity will be shown to students on the first day of class.
A relevant handout on the ethics of research will be provided to students...followed by a review of it.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
All are welcome...especially international students!
Conducted in English.
This will be a very useful and interesting course, where you get to learn all sorts of different cultures and how to deal with them.
There will be generous cash prizes handed out by the instructor for the best assignments and the best presentations.
Most of all, there will be NO tests.
This will for sure be a rare opportunity.
So...what are you waiting for?
Come on and join us.
However, that said...
No plagiarism allowed.
All are welcome...especially international students!
